en: Rood
Listen to me! Ghetsis never cared for Pokémon. Freeing them was only a tale to win Unova for himself!
Grunt
Save your speeches, old man. You walked out on Team Plasma. Traitors don't get a say!
{rival}
Well, talking didn't work. {player}, you're just in time!
Out of the way! I'm here for a Pokémon you people stole, and I'm not leaving without it!
Grunt
A couple of kids? Don't make us laugh. Nobody gets near the Plasma Frigate!
{rival}
Fine! I'll take this one. {player}, you take the other!
Grunt
We'll flatten you both, and the traitors with you!
Grunt
Ugh... Retreat! Back to the ship, everyone!
Rood
Are your Pokémon hurt? Here, let my friends see to them.
Rood's sages tended the team. Everyone is full of energy again!
Rood
We believed, once, that we fought for a world kinder to Pokémon. We were blind to what Ghetsis truly wanted.
Now we must make amends. We will hold this ground. You two, go aboard by the ramp to the north-east and stop him!
And you, young man. The Purrloin you seek is most likely held by the Shadow Triad, Ghetsis's own shadows.
{rival}
Then I'll get it back from them myself. If it helps you old Plasma folks make up for things, all the better!
{player}, I'll go first. Don't be long!
Rood
Child, stand back. These are our old comrades, and we will make them listen.
The ramp to the Frigate is to the north-east, across the ice. We will keep the way open for you.
Sage
We will not let the new Team Plasma set foot outside this crater.
Grunt
The boss is going to freeze all of Unova! Then we'll take every Pokémon there is!
